snippet.title: Shelfbound | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Shelfbound release on 30th of september 2026. 

A storm has torn through, sending shelves and their contents flying across the room. In Shelfbound, it’s your job to clean up the mess, sort through scattered items, and put everything back where it belongs, one labeled shelf at a time.
